description: Analyse GeoJSON polygons (Polygon, MultiPolygon, Feature or FeatureCollection): geodesic area (m², km², ha, acres; same spherical formula as Turf.js), perimeter, area-weighted centroid, bounding box, validity report (unclosed or short rings, self-intersections, RFC 7946 winding order), point-in-polygon tests for up to 1,000 points honouring holes and edges, convex hull and optional Douglas-Peucker simplification to a tolerance in metres. Offline. Price: $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/geo-polygon

geometry.description: GeoJSON Polygon / MultiPolygon / Feature / FeatureCollection ([lon, lat] order)

hull.description: Return the convex hull (of the geometry, or of points when no geometry is given)

simplify.description: Douglas-Peucker tolerance in metres (returns simplified geometry)

name: geo_polygon
title: Geo Polygon
